title: Food And Agriculture Organization
definition: A specialized agency of the United Nations that leads international efforts to defeat hunger, eliminate poverty, and achieve food security for all through sustainable agricultural development.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for UPSC CSE Prelims (International Organizations, UN bodies, specialized agencies, headquarters) and Mains GS-2 (International Relations, global governance, UN bodies) and GS-3 (Agriculture, Food Security, PDS, Economics of Agriculture).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, history, and functional mechanisms of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).
Evaluate institutional frameworks, global reports, and India's partnership with the FAO.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims statements regarding specialized UN agencies.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of the United Nations system and specialized agencies.
Core concepts of global food security, nutrition, and sustainable agriculture.
